reviews.review: Quite straight forward like spacemarines should be. It is a challege in harder levels.
really repetitive, but fun. Get on sale.

Dis ain't too naff of a game, yeah.  Good fer gettin' youz stompin' on when waitin' for da WAAAGH to get goin'. 

I wuz a bit disappointed dat ya can't play as da Orkz, but oi, da game iz called "Space Mareen" fer uh reazon, I s'pose.

You play az a Space Mahreen Kaptin from da Ultramareens named Titus.  He's a dead 'ard Humie git who don't give a zog abou' nuffing dat would try to duff 'im.  Ya see, he ain't none too 'appy about a Warboss from da Evil Sunz tryin' to loot a Humie planet.  Anywayz, Titus stomps dat naff boy an' saves da planet... 'cept fingz ain't wat dey seem.

Da gud fings:

"Space Mareen" iz a fun slog thru da 40k world an' shows lotza diffent fings abou' it dat makes it da best place to WAAGH.

Lotza choppas an' shootas to chooze from... 
   Well, sorta... More on dat below, actually.

Fun multaplaya, yeah, but dat don't mean much now 'cuz they ain't many of da boyz playin' it.

It duz not get dat boring even afta playin it fer a while.

Da Naff Fings:

Not enuff choppy.  
     Dem Space Mehreens iz good at makin' gud choppaz, but dey don't seem to 'ave very many of dem in dis 'un.  No Power Swords, Power Fists or Power Klawz fer Titus.  He getz a Power Axe and a Thunda Hammer at least. He 'az his chainsword o'course.  It iz ratha 'ard to fight with dem, too.  Titus can take sum hits, but he is not dat great at not gettin' hit in da first place. o'course he can roll 'round like a kicked grot but dat just gets borin'. Come on, ya Humie git, dinnit dey teach ya to blokk once an' a while?

Meltas don't work like dey should.  
     'stead of a deff beam dat krumps any git dat ya point it at, da melta jus' spreadz out like a naff shottgunn.  Still hurtz, but zog, get it roight!

Da Blasta ('scuze me, Plazma) shootas iz a bit 'ard ta hit fings. 
    It'll snik whateva it hitz, dough.

No Burna weaponz
   Nope, none 'round here.  If you wanna light sum gitz on fire youz best look for anotha game.

Not a lotta gitz.
   You will be stompin and shootin Gretchinz an' Ork Boyz, mostly.  o'course there iz a few nobz or oddboyz thrown in.  After sum time you'll be krumpin' sum Chaos Humies and demon gitz later. Datz pretty much it.  Toss in a few Panzees or even sum of dem blue skinned gitz an bugz and it'll be a real WAAGH.

Anywayz, "Space Mareen" iz a proppa game, and if you get enuff teef you wuldn't go wrong buyin dis game.

Good fun. Decent story.

The feeling of tromping around, near invincible, while slaughtering heretics and xenos, at both range and in close quarters was awesome.

Would love to see more!
Gears of War on freebase crack cocaine
